§6Capacitors§f §aPower storage that discharges fast. From 600 kHE copper cells to 6 GHE spark monsters.§f §bCapacitors§f are power storage devices that discharge large amounts of power rapidly, making them vital for power banks supporting high-power operations. §6Tiers§f:
§b• Copper§f, 600 kHE, 1 kHE/t (Chemical Plant)
§b• Gold§f, 6 MHE, 10 kHE/t (Assembly Machine)
§b• Niobium§f, 60 MHE, 100 kHE/t (Assembly Factory)
§b• Tantalum§f, 300 MHE, 500 kHE/t (Assembly Factory)
§b• Bismuth§f, 1.5 GHE, 2.5 MHE/t (Assembly Factory + QPU)
§b• Spark§f, 6 GHE, 10 MHE/t (Assembly Factory + Cold Perfluoromethyl) §ePS:§f Copper for early buffers, tantalum for mid-game, Spark for end-game machines like the Particle Accelerator and ICF. Higher tiers charge and discharge faster, critical for burst-power machines.
